correctness.rationale: All three rational-root filters are exhaustive. Twelve geometric smoothness chart tests have Groebner unit ideal; genus follows from adjunction. Classical Hasse-Witt extraction produces exact mod-p matrices, confirmed by independent coefficient expansion. Determinants 1 mod3, 4 mod5, and zero mod7 plus nonzero 35x35 minors (4,4) determine ranks; nonzero 35x35 minors (3,4) for the squares show stable rank35. The rank defect gives a-number1, and the p-rank plus Newton symmetry and slope denominators forces the remaining slopes 1/2,1/2. Finite exact computations exhaust every case claimed; no extrapolation.

value.rationale: Asgarli–Ghioca introduce a natural near-minimal-degree plane-filling family, and published results for minimum-degree Tallini curves motivate its Jacobian arithmetic. Classifying the exact p-ranks and a-numbers for all geometrically smooth members in the first three odd prime fields identifies the first prime at which ordinarity fails in this family and records the exact Newton polygon. The anomaly is a motivated finite arithmetic boundary not supplied by genus or rational-point counts; no broad conjectural consequence is claimed.
